use_feedbacktype_enum: use the FeedbackType enum to classify dialogue feedback as perfect, better search query, better doc, better history, better others, or none
check_nosearch_constant: check if a search result equals the NO_SEARCH sentinel string to detect missing search
use_title_passage_delimiter: use the TITLE_PASSAGE_DELIMITER constant to join or split document title and passage text
check_ok_label: check if a dialogue turn label equals OK_LABEL to determine if the response is acceptable
filter_unwanted_tokens: filter out tokens from the UNWANTED_TOKENS list to clean dialogue data
